df0 = Table_0[Table_0['annee'] == 2016]
df1 = Table_1[Table_1['annee'] == 2016]
df2 = Table_2[(Table_2['annee'] == 2016) & (Table_2['categorie_hierarchique'].str.upper() == 'B')]
agg_detach = (
    df0.groupby('collectivite', as_index=False)
    .agg(women_detach_sum=('nombre_de_femmes', 'sum'),
         men_detach_sum=('nombre_d_hommes', 'sum'))

    df1.groupby('collectivite', as_index=False)
    .agg(women_perm_sum=('nombre_de_femmes', 'sum'),

    df2.groupby('collectivite', as_index=False)
    .agg(women_catB_sum=('nombre_de_femmes_au_31_decembre', 'sum'),
         men_catB_sum=('nombre_d_hommes_au_31_decembre', 'sum'))
)

    pd.concat([df0[['collectivite']], df1[['collectivite']], df2[['collectivite']]])
    .drop_duplicates()
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
merged = (
    base_collectivite
    .merge(agg_detach, on='collectivite', how='left')
    .merge(agg_perm, on='collectivite', how='left')
    .merge(agg_catB, on='collectivite', how='left')

merged['share_perm'] = merged['women_perm_sum'] / (merged['women_perm_sum'] + merged['men_perm_sum']).replace(0, np.nan)
merged['share_catB'] = merged['women_catB_sum'] / (merged['women_catB_sum'] + merged['men_catB_sum']).replace(0, np.nan)
